honest_scope: One 2023-2026 bull regime, roughly ten independent windows. Nothing here can promote anything; the purpose is to decide whether the candidate deserves a forward clock.

portfolio.benchmark: equal-weight panel of all priced issuers
portfolio.breadth_rationale: Step 190 showed that in this cross-section breadth captures skew rather than sacrificing return. If that holds, wider books should not lose to narrow ones.

price_hygiene.rationale: Zero prices are data errors, not trades. Capping weekly moves at +200% keeps genuine microcap moves while preventing a single bad print from dominating a decile mean. Checked before adopting: cleaning moves the non-overlapping spread from +2.43% to +2.17% per 13 weeks, so the signal does not depend on the bad prints.

question: The discovery program used overlapping weekly windows. This asks whether the effect survives strictly non-overlapping evaluation, and whether it produces a usable portfolio once costs, execution delay and breadth are applied.
source: Cooper, Gulen & Schill (2008). Negative of year-on-year total asset growth, standardised within SIC sector.

strict_evaluation.note: Weekly evaluation of a 13-week forward return reuses each observation thirteen times. Non-overlapping windows give genuinely independent observations at the cost of a much smaller sample, which is the honest trade.

v1_defect: v1's equal-weight benchmark returned infinity. The price panel contains 52 zero prices, one of which produces an infinite weekly return, plus 12 observations above +1000% in a single week. The benchmark comparison gate in v1 is therefore meaningless and is superseded rather than trusted.
